items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: He bought the first guitar for me, which was a four-string. I was playing trombone and guitar in his show.

ctx.x: Because I'd always borrow them and use them, borrow and travel and give it back. He bought the first guitar for me, which was a four-string. I was playing trombone and guitar in his show.
This was before you went with the 101 Ranch?
